channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic presidential election; Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede
item.description: It's the first time since Brazil returned to direct elections in 1989 that a candidate has won the final runoff after losing in the first round.

item.title: Oil slides over 2% as traders weigh Saudi attack risks, demand destruction
item.description: Oil prices fell as investors weighed the threat of further attacks on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure against concerns that elevated prices could erode demand.

item.title: Defense tech investment boom sparks bubble warning as private equity pours in
item.description: Private equity growth investments in defense reached $4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up from $500 million in 2024.

item.title: Stock futures climb as traders try to recover from the S&P 500's losing week: Live updates
item.description: Traders looked ahead to a busy week with the Federal Reserve's policy decision due on Wednesday.

item.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says
item.description: Elon Musk said in an X post that SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase GPUs.

item.title: ‘Ticking time bomb’: The world's pension funds face an ageing crisis
item.description: The world's pension systems are confronting a demographic crisis as longer lifespans and dwindling birth rates threaten to stretch retirement finances.

item.title: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in aspiring 'AI nation' Malaysia
item.description: SoftBank Group reportedly plans to invest $50 billion in Malaysia's technology sector, including artificial intelligence and data centers.

item.title: Goldman Sachs slashes Kospi target to 9,000 but still sees over 60% upside
item.description: Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25% to 9,000 but maintained its bullish outlook on Korean equities.

item.title: Blanche defends Trump-ordered lawsuit over Alaska Senate election certification
item.description: Democrats have maintained they have no connection to Daniel J. Sullivan.

item.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms during drone operations
item.description: Ukraine challenged Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms, arguing that commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.

item.title: America by the numbers: How voters feel about the economy, inflation, AI and Trump
item.description: With the U.S. midterm elections looming, Americans are nearly as gloomy about the economy as they were when the nation was emerging from the pandemic.

item.title: What Democrats and Republicans fear most about each other: CNBC survey has the answers
item.description: The economy is still a key issue in the 2026 election, but voters are concerned about Trump testing the bounds of the office and Democratic Socialist polices.

item.title: Trump invokes 9/11 in urging Michigan voters to oppose Muslim Senate candidate El-Sayed
item.description: Michigan has one of the nation's most competitive U.S. Senate races heading into the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

item.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
item.description: Audi's CEO defended the company's plans for a $4 billion plant in Georgia, calling it a business decision to grow sales and reduce exposure to U.S. tariffs.

item.title: Behind ‘Mad Money’ was a brilliant writer viewers never saw. We lost him too soon
item.description: Jim Cramer remembers Cliff Mason, the head writer of "Mad Money," who died last week at age 41.

item.title: SpaceX coverage network designs draw Wall Street's eye. Here's what analysts think
item.description: Rooftops and billboards may be more important than hefty infrastructure.

item.title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
item.description: As Nvidia has gone from chipmaker to industry financier, some investors see the company taking on outsized risk tied to the AI buildout.

item.title: More pain may be coming for the AI trade. Why I’m not giving up on it
item.description: In his Sunday column for Investing Club subscribers, Jim Cramer explains why the AI trade has cracked and what he's doing about it.

item.title: In pictures: Protests over inequality, rising living costs turn violent across France
item.description: Protests over inequality and living costs drew an estimated 410,000 people across France, with clashes in several cities for a second straight weekend.

item.title: Earnings playbook: Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon and more report this week. Here's what to expect
item.description: The megacaps are some of the 160 S&P 500 companies expected to report at a critical time for tech and the market.

item.title: Why popular airplanes are getting scrapped years early
item.description: Airplanes are getting dismantled for parts years ahead of schedule because engines and other components are in short supply.

item.title: Now is your last chance to qualify for a Southwest Companion Pass with a credit card bonus
item.description: Southwest is rolling out major changes to how you can earn elite status and its Companion Pass. Apply for a Southwest credit card by Dec. 2, 2026, to help earn the pass.

item.title: Marc Lore’s Wonder bets on Texas, automation and user-built restaurants as it mulls IPO
item.description: Wonder is leaning into automation and user-built restaurants as founder Marc Lore prepares the startup for a potential IPO.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted missiles and drones from Iran-backed Houthis
item.description: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted Houthi missiles and drones, while the Houthis claimed attacks on airports and energy sites amid rising regional supply risks.

item.title: Trump's executive order targets mortgage insurance, refinance costs. What it means for borrowers
item.description: Trump's executive order on housing aims to lower mortgage costs. Here's what it means for homeowners and buyers.

item.title: JetBlue creditors are working with restructuring adviser PJT Partners, WSJ reports
item.description: A surge in jet fuel expenses due to the Iran war has pressured margins for U.S. airlines despite higher airfares and steady demand for air travel.

item.title: Serbia’s strongman leader Vucic concedes defeat to student-led movement in seismic political shift
item.description: It was a seismic political shift in the Balkan country where Vucic led with virtually absolute power for 14 years.

item.title: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile, as doubts over democracy deepen
item.description: Venezuela's opposition leader Edmundo Gonzalez wrote on X, confirming Machado's arrival and saying he would be next to her "very soon."

item.title: Trump is pushing a massive AI buildout. His own voters are wary of what comes with it
item.description: A new CNBC survey finds broad voter opposition to nearby AI data centers, creating a political challenge for Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm election.

item.title: What next for France as riots rattle markets? Three questions facing investors ahead of more protests
item.description: French unrest pushed bond yields to a 24-year high as investors weigh budget, growth and sectors risks ahead of more protests.
